Your Role as IT System Administrator/ Infrastructure Engineer
 As an IT System Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer, your primary responsibility is the administration and operation of Microsoft Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server environments. You ensure the availability, performance, security, and reliability of production systems and support them throughout their full lifecycle, from provisioning and implementation through day-to-day operations, maintenance, and decommissioning.
 Key Responsibilities
Windows Server Administration: Install, configure, operate, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server environments to ensure high availability, performance and security.
Microsoft SQL Server: Operate and manage Microsoft SQL Server environments, including monitoring, performance optimization, maintenance, backup, recovery, and troubleshooting.
Server Lifecycle Management: Manage systems throughout their complete lifecycle, including provisioning and implementation, configuration and hardening, patch and update management, capacity management, documentation, CMDB maintenance, and decommissioning.
Identity & Access Management: Perform basic administration of Active Directory, users, groups, and Group Policies (GPO).
Incident & Request Management: Analyze, troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests using the established ticketing system; document findings and solutions clearly.
Change Management: Plan, document, and implement changes to production infrastructure.
Backup & Recovery: Support backup, restore, and disaster recovery activities.
Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and configuration information.
International Collaboration: Work closely with international IT teams, application teams, and external service providers.
 Your Profile
Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
At least three years of professional experience in the areas and technologies outlined in this job profile.
Solid understanding of server lifecycle management, patch and update management, monitoring and troubleshooting, backup and restore, IT security, and system hardening.
Basic knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy (GPO).
Understanding of Incident, Request, and Change Management processes, ideally in an ITIL-based environment.
Structured, independent, and reliable way of working with a strong sense of ownership.
Willingness to take operational responsibility for production systems.
Very good English, both written and spoken, for collaboration with international teams and headquarters. German language or any other foreign language is a plus.
 What we offer
Professional development: you will be part of an international team committed to support you to learn new skills and shape a career path that fits you, with access to various learning platforms;
Onboarding & Integration: we ensure a smooth and efficient integration through a structured onboarding program, complemented by the ongoing support of a collaborative team;
We prioritize your well-being: therefore we’re granting access to high-quality healthcare services through our comprehensive private medical insurance;
Meal tickets: we support your everyday routine with meal tickets to make your workdays a little easier and more enjoyable;
Commuting made easier with public transport cost reimbursement.
Gifts for Special Occasions: Easter Holidays, Winter Holidays, 8th of March for our ladies colleagues;
Flexibility: we support a healthy work-life balance by offering flexible arrangements tailored to your role and responsibilities;
Bonuses: performance bonuses as a reward of your achievements and referral bonuses as a thank you for helping our team growth.
